scenario.authoritativePath: HTTP C03 SEARCH -> C04 PREPARE -> C04 CONFIRM -> PostgreSQL

inferred.statement: At most one authoritative conflicting allocation survived, and exact retries created no additional reservation.
inferred.basis: Observed persisted counts, exclusion-constrained allocation rows, retry readback, and zero overlapping active allocation pairs.

secondaryProof.note: The PostgreSQL integration proof was run in a second freshly migrated and seeded disposable database.

proofHarnessFinding.detail: The first parity run expected venue/resource UUIDs from a guest-safe projection that intentionally no longer exposes them. The integration proof was updated to inspect allocations through a tenant-scoped authoritative database read; production behavior was not changed.

finalPersistedQuery.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT r.reservation_id) FILTER (WHERE r.status='CONFIRMED'), count(DISTINCT a.allocation_id) FILTER (WHERE a.released_at IS NULL) FROM reservation_core.reservations r LEFT JOIN reservation_core.reservation_allocations a ON a.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND a.reservation_id=r.reservation_id WHERE r.tenant_id=$1 AND r.venue_id=$2 AND tstzrange(r.starts_at,r.ends_at,'[)') && tstzrange($3::timestamptz,$4::timestamptz,'[)');

reproduction.precondition: Use a fresh PostgreSQL 17 cluster/database only; never point these commands at the retained demo database.
